Book correction: The answer key (page 297) prints z=2\pm i\sqrt{21}. This is wrong: the real part is half of 6, i.e. 3 (with real part 2 the roots would add up to 4, not 6). Correct: z=3\pm i\sqrt{21}.

Book correction: The answer key (page 297) prints z=3\pm i. This is wrong: z=3+i gives 3(3+i)^{2}-18(3+i)+50=20, not 0. Completing the square gives (z-3)^{2}=-\frac{23}{3}. Correct: z=3\pm\frac{\sqrt{69}}{3}\,i.

Book correction: The book labels the six parts of this question (i), (ii), (iii), (i), (ii), (iii); here they are (i) to (vi). For this part the answer key (page 297) prints z=\frac{5\pm i\sqrt{41}}{6}. This is wrong: the discriminant is 25-84=-59, not -41. Correct: z=\frac{5\pm i\sqrt{59}}{6}.
